panels.label: grasp on the desk
panels.shows: the right hand closed on the cube at its parked place on the desk, in front of the rail

panels.label: lift onto the rail
panels.shows: the cube in the hand at rail height at the near end of the rail, just before it is set down

panels.label: slide along the rail
panels.shows: the cube on the rail about half way along, the hand on top of it

panels.label: far end of the rail
panels.shows: the cube resting at the far end of the rail with the hand drawn back from it (the hand is still on the cube at frame 895); 898 rather than 899 because the Unity capture never writes the recording's last frame, and the two colour frames are indistinguishable

release: the hand leaves the cube in the last frames of the recording: on it at frame 895, withdrawn and blurred at frames 898 and 899, the cube at rest on the rail
